g.text: Implementation differences on the large inputs
Median and IQR of nine paired round ratios. Same inputs for all implementations; baseline is JVRUST = 1.
Companion large-matrix runtime charts include the SciPy baselines. These ratios compare implementations/builds, not programming languages in general.
